name: Impurities
source:
In Impurities, you play as a young man named Damien (name is changeable). One day, during a regular morning, the debt collectors show up at your door and your mother informs you that your late father left behind a large amount of debt that needs to be paid ASAP, or else your family might lose their home. Soon after, you are going to find out that’s the least of your problems. You’ll have to make a very tough decision to save your family from this dire situation.
What will you choose to do? The fate of the Sinclair family is in your hands…
translation:
在《杂质》中，你扮演一个名叫达米安（Damien）的年轻人（名字可以更改）。有一天，在一个平常的早晨，收债人出现在你家门口，你的母亲告诉你，你已故的父亲留下了一大笔债务，需要尽快偿还，否则你的家人可能会失去家园。不久之后，你就会发现这是最不重要的问题。你必须做出一个非常艰难的决定才能将你的家人从这种可怕的境地中拯救出来。
你会选择做什么？辛克莱家族的命运掌握在你的手中……
